the IoMNT is an emerging research field with many challenges and open problems, which is of great importance in terms of applications and impact on our society.
the IoMNT will enable the development of a plethora of novel applications and services in a wide range of fields including biomedical, security and defence, environmental and industrial.

we developed the following: (i) an efficient medium access protocol for the IoMNET, (ii) a novel cross-layer communication module for the IoMNet, (iii) an efficient routing protocol for the IoMT, (iv) a novel addressing scheme for the IoM, (v) a novel neighbor discovery mechanism, and (vi) a novel security solution for the IoM.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the realization of the future Internet of Multimedia Nano-things.
the design and implementation of the physical layer, the medium access control, and the routing layer for the Internet of Multimedia Things (IoMT).
the design, development, and implementation of a novel QoS framework for the IoMnt.

the IoMNT is still in its infancy and a lot of research challenges need to be tackled before the IoMNT can be realized.
the realization of the IoT and IoMNT is not a matter of technology, but of a paradigm shift in the way we perceive the world and the role of technology in it.
the Internet of Multimedia Nanodevices (IoMND) is a truly cyber-physical system that will enable a plethora of novel applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

this paper presents a novel vision for the Internet of Things (IoT), where the Internet is populated with multimedia devices at the nanoscales, and the interconnection of these nano-devices with the existing communication networks and the Internet defines a new communication paradigm that is referred to as the IoMNT.
we are developing a novel cyber-physical system, the Internet of Multimedia Nanodevices.
we are the only group that has done research in the IoMNT field.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Internet of Things is not a static concept.
the IoMNT is not only a novel communication paradigm but a novel computing paradigm as well.
the Internet of Multimedia Nanoscale Things is an exciting new research field with a wide range of applications in various areas.
